messages:
mira: Quick proposal — small CLI/bot helper called `rollpatch` to streamline tiny rollouts and make rollback markers first-class. idea is one command to create a deploy ticket, generate compact release notes, pin a rollback checkpoint, and optionally schedule a change window. keeps the common fastpath ergonomic.

alex: Nice. want it to be non-invasive for big releases — just helpful for fast patches & config flips. what flags are you thinking?

mira: Minimal UX: `/rollpatch start --pr 4321 --env prod --window '22:00-23:00' --pin checkpoint --notes-from-pr` defaults to dry-run unless `--go`. Example output: a short release note snippet + a rollback marker ID.

sam: Love `--notes-from-pr`. We can grab PR title + first paragraph, remove CI noise. Also include quick checklist lines: rollback command, service owners, slack link.

mira: Exactly. rough example output: ```
Release: hotfix/metrics-pulse (PR #4321)
Window: 22:00-23:00 UTC
Notes: Fix race in KV cache that caused 5xx for short sequences.
Rollback: rlbk-2026-05-17-8a3f (run: `rollpatch rollback rlbk-2026-05-17-8a3f`)
Owners: @sam @jordan
Change-ids: model:v2.1.3, runtime:stable
```

jordan: Can `rollpatch` create a lightweight changelog entry in the release tracker and attach the rollback ID? That would be huge for oncall.

mira: Yes — plan is to POST a compact entry to the release service with fields: pr, summary, rollback_id, owners, window. Also post a thread in #incidents or #releases if `--announce`.

alex: How do we ensure pins don't get stale? We had issues with pinned manifests lingering.

mira: Two mitigations: 1) auto-expire pins after a configurable TTL (default 72h) unless `--pin persistent` is used, 2) annotate pins with the snapshot manifest + commit sha so automated cleanup can detect drift.

sam: Ops question — during a quick hotfix, we want a one-click rollback from the Slack thread. Can deploy-bot support `rollpatch rollback <id>`?

deploy-bot: I can accept `/rollpatch rollback rlbk-2026-05-17-8a3f --confirm` and run the rollback pipeline. Requires two approvers for prod by default.

jordan: Nice. Also suggest adding `--canary=10%` flag to create a temporary canary route and fallback policy wired into the rollout.

mira: Yup. canary + auto-fallback if error rate > threshold. Implementation note: runtime will auto-route back to previous variant and keep the rollback marker intact.

alex: For release notes template, can we include a one-line TL;DR and a single bullet for impact + mitigation? PMs love that.

mira: plan: generated notes include 1-line summary, impact (users affected, SLO buckets), immediate mitigation steps, rollback command, and a link to the PR and changelog entry. Example: ```
TLDR: Fix race causing 5xx for short-gen requests.
Impact: ~0.3% of gen requests; elevated 5xx on p99 latency windows.
Mitigation: revert via `rollpatch rollback rlbk-2026-05-17-8a3f` or disable cache via runtime toggle.
```

sam: Implementation path: 1) small CLI + server endpoint to create pins + changelog 2) git/github integration to fetch PR metadata 3) deploy-bot command wiring (dry-run + confirm) 4) add quick templates to Console (observability link auto-insert). estimate 3-4 days for a minimal MVP.

mira: MVP should intentionally avoid touching existing deploy flows — it just creates metadata + hooks that existing pipelines can optionally consume. Later we can add autopromote.

alex: QA checklist for MVP?

mira: Minimal QA: run `/rollpatch start` with `--env staging`, verify changelog entry + pin created, verify `rollpatch rollback` can be initiated and sets a flagged rollback event, test auto-expire behavior. Also confirm notifications to channels and that owners are pinged.

jordan: I'll volunteer to own the console bits (link generation + quick action). sam will own runtime rollback hook. alex can review infra.

mira: sweet. I'll put a short RFC + a tiny CLI repo skeleton in GH and open a draft PR for the bot wiring. will ping the thread when ready. :rocket:
